name: declines a task no registered skill covers
input: Provision a three-node Postgres cluster in us-east-1, enable point-in-time recovery, and return the connection string.

assertions.why: no registered skill provisions infrastructure; naming one anyway sends the task somewhere that cannot do it and reports a guess as a routing decision
a decline is a decision the caller can act on, and it has to arrive as one rather than as a router failure
